evaluation_scope: Separate local offline studies, not official challenge scores.

studies.label: Answer-guided temporal refinement
studies.change: One additional 64-frame pass within ±15 seconds of the first answer.
studies.boundary: Earlier Segment checkpoint; this is not an overall track score.
studies.source: Segment inference temporal-cascade comments; archived spotlight fact check.

studies.label: Question-anchored evidence windows
studies.change: Spend the same 64 frames inside ±30-second question-anchored windows.
studies.boundary: A separate question population from the refinement study.

studies.label: Coarse-to-fine temporal search
studies.change: Three passes: full procedure → 1,200 seconds → 100 seconds, at 128/128/64 frames.
studies.boundary: Single-checkpoint search study before the later W64/NW2 routing split.
studies.source: Procedure inference temporal-cascade comments; archived spotlight fact check.
